token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY graduation

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the (token, quote) pair is deployed before graduation

token_a_reserve_wei.meaning: internal reserve of tokenA in the pair after the direct deposit and sync
token_a_reserve_wei.checkpoint: after attacker deposit and sync, before graduation

graduation_completed_without_revert.meaning: graduation deposits 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool without reverting

users_forced_to_withdraw_all_quote.meaning: users are forced to pull out all of their quote

assumptions: The attacker is an unprivileged caller able to deposit 1 wei and call sync on the pair.
The 20% token and all quoteReserve deposit amounts are the intended graduation logic, not observed values.
The pair is the (token, quote) UniSwapV2 pair used by the launchpad at graduation.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact BONDING_SUPPLY threshold value or the precise 'near graduation' distance; only the qualitative near-graduation state is given.
Report does not give numeric definitions for the 20% token amount or the held quoteReserve amount; the graduation deposit is represented as a qualitative completion outcome.

limitations: The forced-withdrawal impact is encoded as a qualitative Boolean because the report gives no numeric quote amounts.
Permanence of the graduation DoS is asserted but not independently established; the plan encodes the reported scenario only.
